title: Secondary data supporting "An unstructured finite-volume Helmholtz method with perfectly matched layers for heterogeneous two-phase acoustics"
description: Secondary numerical data, sampled numerical and analytical pressure profiles, convergence/error summaries, integrated radiation-force results, and original illustration sources underlying all 19 figures and 7 tables of the identified manuscript. Includes self-contained reproduction and validation tools; excludes raw simulation fields and meshes.
metadata_note: Draft only. Dataset creators, subject classification, collection and license need the authors' deposit choices. Manuscript authors are recorded as manuscript metadata, not asserted to be the final dataset creators.
